verdict.rationale: Check documents an official CLI meant to "integrate Check into your scripts and CI/CD pipelines," with JSON output by default for piping through jq. API-key auth is offered specifically for agents running on servers "with no browser to drive," and a self-hosted MCP server is configured via environment variables. A sandbox environment lets automation run against simulated data without touching real companies. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, explicit documentation of non-interactive CLI authentication or a worked CI pipeline example.
